title: Artesunate alleviates chronic allergic rhinitis and asthma syndrome via the CCR3/NF-kappaB pathway: a comprehensive analysis.
authors: Zhang, Zhi-Qiang; Bao, You-Wei; Wang, Hongyou; Wang, Heng; Yang, Xinyue; Li, Jing-Yang; Chen, Qi; Wu, Jun; Zhu, Xin-Hua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿琥酯通过CCR3/NF-kappaB通路缓解过敏性鼻炎哮喘综合征，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic allergic rhinitis and asthma syndrome (CARAS) is a comorbid inflammatory condition affecting both upper and lower airways, with limited treatment options. Artesunate (ART), a derivative of artemisinin, has shown anti-inflammatory properties, but its role in CARAS remains unclear. OBJECTIVE: To explore the therapeutic mechanisms of ART in CARAS using a comprehensive multi-methodological approach, focusing on the CCR3/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. METHODS: A CARAS mouse model was established to evaluate the in vivo effects of ART. Network pharmacology, RNA sequencing, and machine learning were applied to identify key targets and pathways. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations assessed ART-target interactions. Western blotting validated critical signaling changes. RESULTS: ART treatment alleviated nasal and lung tissue damage, reduced inflammation, and restored epithelial integrity. It significantly lowered serum IgE and Th2-related cytokines (IL-4, IL-5, IL-13). Network pharmacology identified 29 target genes involved in pathways such as Th17 differentiation and NF-kappaB signaling. Machine learning consistently highlighted STAT3 as a central target. Docking studies showed high binding affinity between ART and STAT3. ART also downregulated CCR3 and inhibited NF-kappaB activation as confirmed by Western blot. CONCLUSION: ART effectively ameliorates CARAS by suppressing inflammation and modulating immune signaling via the CCR3/NF-kappaB axis. These findings support ART as a potential therapeutic agent for CARAS.
abstract_zh: 背景：慢性过敏性鼻炎和哮喘综合征（CARAS）是一种影响上、下气道的共病性炎症状态，治疗选择有限。青蒿琥酯（ART）是青蒿素的衍生物，已显示出抗炎特性，但其在CARAS中的作用尚不明确。目的：采用综合多方法学方法，聚焦CCR3/NF-kappaB信号通路，探讨ART在CARAS中的治疗机制。方法：建立CARAS小鼠模型，评估ART的体内效应。应用网络药理学、RNA测序和机器学习识别关键靶点和通路。分子对接和分子动力学模拟评估ART与靶点的相互作用。Western blotting验证关键信号变化。结果：ART治疗减轻了鼻和肺组织损伤，减少了炎症，并恢复了上皮完整性。它显著降低了血清IgE和Th2相关细胞因子（IL-4、IL-5、IL-13）。网络药理学识别出29个靶基因，涉及Th17分化和NF-kappaB信号等通路。机器学习一致突出STAT3作为核心靶点。对接研究显示ART与STAT3之间具有高结合亲和力。ART还下调了CCR3，并抑制了NF-kappaB激活，经Western blot证实。结论：ART通过CCR3/NF-kappaB轴抑制炎症和调节免疫信号，有效改善CARAS。这些发现支持ART作为CARAS的潜在治疗药物。
